(c) −Im(Z) as a function of the void area fraction at several frequencies. ■CONCLUSIONS In this study, an early-detection strategy for the interfacial degradation at Li|SE interfaces during stripping is developed based on GEIS measurements and tested for LPSCl SE and LLZO SE. We demonstrate that using the raw impedance signal at a single frequency is sufficient to detect interfacial degradation. The imaginary component of impedance increases more rapidly compared to the cell polarization in the low- frequency range, which is strongly correlated with charge transfer at the Li|SE interface, making it a promising descriptor for cell degradation.
